<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>
/* Plataforma de assinatura B2B para quem vende ao poder público. Padrão internacional: muito ar, grotesca limpa, dourado como toque. */
:root{
  --bg:#0C0F13; --bg2:#101419; --surface:#151A20; --surface2:#1A2027;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.07); --line2:rgba(255,255,255,.12); --line-gold:rgba(203,165,92,.32);
  --fg:#F4F2EC; --fg-soft:#D7D4CC; --muted:#8E938F;
  --gold:#CBA55C; --gold-hi:#E8D29A; --gold-deep:#8F6E31;
  --good:#8FBDA3; --bad:#D6897A;
  --maxw:1140px; --pad:clamp(72px,9vw,120px);
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0}
body{background:var(--bg)!important;color:var(--fg);font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;font-weight:400}
h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0;font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;text-wrap:balance;color:var(--fg);font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",-apple-system,sans-serif}
summary,b,th{color:inherit}
.btn,.btn:hover,.btn:focus{text-decoration:none!important}
.btn-gold,.btn-gold:hover{color:#241A06!important}
a{color:inherit}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{width:100%;max-width:var(--maxw);margin-inline:auto;padding-left:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.band{width:100%}
.kick{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.kick::before{content:"";width:22px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);opacity:.6}

/* logo */
.logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.logo .mk{height:50px;width:auto;aspect-ratio:833/1253;flex:none;color:var(--fg)}
.logo b{font-weight:700;font-size:1.85rem;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--gold)}
.logo .tag{font-weight:500;font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:2px}
.logo .wm{line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.3em;white-space:nowrap}.logo .wm i{font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-size:1.85rem;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--fg)}@media(max-width:600px){.logo .wm i,.logo .wm b{font-size:1.15rem!important}}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .14s ease,background .18s,border-color .18s,color .18s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#241A06}
.btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold-hi)}
.btn-ghost{border-color:var(--line2);color:var(--fg)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold-hi)}
.btn-lg{padding:16px 30px;font-size:1.04rem}

/* nav */
.nav{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:30;background:rgba(12,15,19,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:31;background:var(--bg)}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding-block:14px}
.nav nav{display:flex;gap:34px}
.nav nav a{color:var(--fg-soft);font-weight:500;font-size:.96rem;transition:color .15s}
.nav nav a:hover{color:var(--gold-hi)}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px}
.enter{color:var(--fg);font-weight:600;font-size:.96rem}
.enter:hover{color:var(--gold-hi)}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(900px 480px at 85% -10%,rgba(203,165,92,.13),transparent 58%);pointer-events:none}
.hero .ghost{position:absolute;right:-2%;bottom:-8%;height:104%;width:auto;aspect-ratio:833/1253;color:var(--fg);opacity:.045;pointer-events:none}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;padding-block:clamp(70px,10vw,120px)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5.4vw,4.2rem);font-weight:800}
.hero .sub{color:var(--fg-soft);font-size:clamp(1.08rem,1.5vw,1.22rem);margin-top:26px;max-width:40ch;font-weight:400}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:38px}
.hero-meta{margin-top:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.hero-meta .d{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--good)}

/* product glass panel */
.glass{background:linear-gradient(165deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055),rgba(255,255,255,.015));border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);box-shadow:0 40px 90px -45px rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.g-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px}
.g-head .t{font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.g-head .src{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 11px}
.g-hero-num{font-size:2.5rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--bad);line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.g-hero-lbl{color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;margin-top:6px}
.g-div{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:22px 0}
.g-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}
.g-row+.g-row{margin-top:14px}
.g-row .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
.g-row .dot.b{background:var(--bad)}
.g-row .dot.g{background:var(--good)}
.g-row .lbl{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:.93rem;color:var(--fg-soft)}
.g-row .val{font-weight:700;font-size:.93rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.g-note{margin-top:20px;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}

/* sections */
.sec{padding-block:var(--pad);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.sec-head{max-width:34ch}
.sec-head.ctr{max-width:52ch;margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.9rem);margin-top:18px}
.sec-head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:18px;font-size:1.08rem;max-width:52ch}
.sec-head.ctr p{margin-inline:auto}

/* trust bar */
.trust{border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2)}
.trust .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(20px,5vw,60px);flex-wrap:wrap;padding-block:26px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500}
.trust b{color:var(--fg-soft);font-weight:600}

/* about */
.about .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(40px,6vw,80px);align-items:center}
.about h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.9rem);margin-top:18px}
.about p{color:var(--fg-soft);font-size:1.1rem;margin-top:20px}
.about p+p{margin-top:16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.02rem}
.figure{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:24px;background:radial-gradient(120% 120% at 20% 10%,rgba(203,165,92,.18),transparent 55%),linear-gradient(160deg,var(--surface),var(--bg2));border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center}
.figure .mk{height:46%;width:auto;aspect-ratio:833/1253;color:var(--fg);opacity:.95}

/* tools */
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;margin-top:56px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
.tool{background:var(--bg);padding:34px 30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;transition:background .2s}
.tool:hover{background:var(--surface)}
.tglyph{width:40px;height:40px;color:var(--gold-hi)}
.tglyph svg{width:40px;height:40px}
.tool h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.tool p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem}
.soon{font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line2);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px}

/* steps */
.steps{background:var(--bg2)}
.steps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,4vw,48px);margin-top:56px}
.step .n{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em}
.step h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin:14px 0 10px}
.step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.step .bar{height:2px;background:var(--line);margin-top:22px;position:relative}
.step .bar::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:100%;width:34%;background:var(--gold)}

/* plans */
.plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:24px;max-width:780px;margin:56px auto 0}
.plan{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:20px;padding:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--surface)}
.plan.feat{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(203,165,92,.07),var(--surface))}
.plan .pn{font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.plan .feat-tag{align-self:flex-start;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#241A06;background:var(--gold);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px}
.price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:5px;margin:18px 0 2px}
.price b{font-size:2.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.price span{color:var(--muted)}
.plan ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:22px 0 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:13px}
.plan li{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--fg-soft)}
.plan li svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--gold);flex:none;margin-top:3px}
.plan .btn{width:100%;margin-top:auto}
.plans-note{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:20px;font-style:italic}

/* insure */
.insure .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.insure .txt{max-width:46ch}
.insure h3{font-size:1.5rem}
.insure p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px}

/* final */
.final{text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.final::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(700px 360px at 50% 130%,rgba(203,165,92,.18),transparent 62%);pointer-events:none}
.final .wrap{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding-block:var(--pad)}
.final h2{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4vw,3rem);max-width:18ch}
.final p{color:var(--fg-soft);max-width:48ch;font-size:1.1rem}

/* footer */
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:54px 40px;background:var(--bg)}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;padding-bottom:34px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.foot-grid .lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin-top:16px;max-width:36ch}
.foot-col h4{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 16px;font-weight:700}
.foot-col a,.foot-col div{display:block;color:var(--fg-soft);font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:11px}
.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--gold-hi)}
.foot-bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem}
.flag{color:var(--gold-hi);border:1px solid var(--line-gold);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px}


/* conversão */
.assure{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:26px 0 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 22px;color:var(--fg-soft);font-size:.92rem}
.assure li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.assure svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--good)}
.stats{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg2)}
.stats .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;padding-block:34px}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.6vw,2.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--gold-hi);line-height:1.05}
.stat span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-top:8px;max-width:24ch}
.cmp-wrap{margin-top:48px;overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px}
.cmp{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:680px}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:20px 22px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.97rem}
.cmp tbody tr:last-child th,.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.cmp thead th{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;background:var(--bg2)}
.cmp thead .yes-h{color:var(--gold)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:700;color:var(--fg);width:28%}
.cmp td{color:var(--fg-soft)}
.cmp td.no{color:var(--muted)}
.cmp td.yes{background:rgba(203,165,92,.05)}
.cmp td span{display:inline}
.cmp td svg{width:16px;height:16px;vertical-align:-3px;margin-right:9px}
.cmp td.no svg{color:var(--bad)} .cmp td.yes svg{color:var(--good)}
.roles-sec{background:var(--bg2)}
.roles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:48px}
.role{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:18px;padding:30px;background:var(--surface)}
.role .rk{font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700}
.role h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin:14px 0 10px}
.role p{color:var(--muted)}
.faq-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
.faq{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.qa{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.qa summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;padding:22px 34px 22px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:1.08rem;position:relative}
.qa summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.qa summary::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:4px;top:18px;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--gold);transition:transform .2s}
.qa[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.qa summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:4px}
.qa p{color:var(--muted);padding:0 0 22px;max-width:62ch}
.sticky-cta{display:none}
@media(max-width:940px){
  .stats .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .roles{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .faq-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .sticky-cta{display:flex;position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:rgba(12,15,19,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-top:1px solid var(--line2);padding:12px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));color:var(--fg-soft);font-size:.9rem}
  .sticky-cta b{color:var(--fg)}
  footer{padding-bottom:110px}
}

@media(max-width:940px){
  .plans{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:520px}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}
  .about .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .figure{max-width:360px}
  .tools{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .steps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .logo .mk{height:40px}
  .logo b{font-size:1.45rem}
  .nav nav{display:none}
  .tools{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .plans{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
